name: Canton
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Canton for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, both from Canton Township. The magic runs from December 5 (the free Winterfest in Cherry Hill Village) through December 31 (Holidays in Heritage lights at Heritage Park). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Canton

  • 2 Christmas events for Canton families (the two Plymouth cards move to the Plymouth page)
  • Free: Winterfest in Cherry Hill Village on December 5, 3 to 7:30 pm
  • Meet Santa: photos with Santa Claus at Winterfest
  • Lights: Holidays in Heritage at Heritage Park, nightly through New Year's Eve
  • Season: December 5 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Canton families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Symphony, Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit and Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village.
